UNION PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
NOTICE: E-ADMIT CARD FOR CIVIL SERVICES (PRELIMINARY) EXAMINATION, 2026

The Union Public Service Commission has uploaded the e-Admit Card for the Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination, 2026 scheduled to be held on 14.06.2026.
Candidates are advised to download their e-Admit Card from the official website (https://upsconline.nic.in) and take a printout thereof.
No paper Admit Card will be issued for this Examination by the Commission.
